nodes.label: jsonschema
nodes.rationale: JSON Schema validation of the document manifest in packages/rag.

nodes.label: referencing
nodes.rationale: JSON Schema $ref registry for evaluation suite and case schemas; direct dependency of packages/rag (Spec 006).

nodes.label: pyyaml
nodes.rationale: Parses YAML frontmatter of knowledge documents.

nodes.label: Runtime configuration (RuntimeSettings, load_runtime_settings)
nodes.rationale: Built once per CLI run (D034).

nodes.label: retrieval_client_factory (check_compatibility=False)
nodes.rationale: Applies config/retrieval.yaml timeouts and skips compatibility checks (Spec 008, D059).

nodes.label: Pandas
nodes.rationale: Data analysis/evaluation support where useful.

nodes.label: SQLite FTS5
nodes.rationale: Standard library, no new dependency; BM25 store and fallback store when Qdrant or the embedding model is unavailable (D050, D058).

nodes.label: One lexical file per access scope (future roles)
nodes.rationale: BM25 statistics are computed over the whole file, so a roles spec needs one file per access scope; today only eligible guest/public chunks are indexed.

nodes.label: Derived local lexical file per collection
BGE-M3 embeddings
nodes.rationale: Chosen for multilingual suitability, English/Malayalam support, local/open-source experimentation and low re-indexing cost during comparisons.

nodes.label: sentence-transformers
nodes.rationale: Loads BGE-M3; brings PyTorch; picks CUDA, mps or CPU automatically.

nodes.label: Optional bge-m3 extra
nodes.rationale: Kept optional in packages/rag so the base install, tests and BM25 fallback need no PyTorch.

nodes.label: Model revision pinned to commit SHA
Device not pinned, recorded in results (D038)
Deterministic fake embedder
nodes.rationale: Lets tests and CI run without the model.

nodes.label: Retrieval fallback to BM25 (Spec 008, D058)
nodes.rationale: hybrid degrades to BM25 on Qdrant or model outage with no new dependency.

nodes.label: Bedrock model selection criteria
nodes.rationale: Exact model not fixed; choose by Mumbai region support, quality, latency, cost and structured-output needs.

nodes.label: Custom retrieval metrics (plain Python)
nodes.rationale: Document-level HitRate@k, Recall@k and MRR in retrieval/metrics.py with no dependency (Spec 005).

nodes.label: LLM-as-judge not sole source of truth
Langfuse
nodes.rationale: RAG/application tracing.

nodes.label: Amazon CloudWatch
nodes.rationale: Infrastructure/application operations.

nodes.label: Relational metadata/workflow/audit database
nodes.rationale: Exact engine intentionally not locked yet.

nodes.label: Intentionally avoided choices
nodes.rationale: Not to be introduced unless a later spec or decision explicitly changes direction.

nodes.label: Bedrock Knowledge Bases as core RAG (avoided)
Heavyweight framework abstractions (avoided)
nodes.rationale: They hide retrieval/evaluation behavior that the project exists to study.

nodes.label: graphify (graphifyy, D048)
nodes.rationale: Knowledge graph of code and docs for coding agents in graphify-out/; not a product or RAG dependency.

nodes.label: Tooling philosophy
nodes.rationale: Prefer plain, inspectable Python and small replaceable interfaces; use frameworks only where they help without obscuring RAG mechanics.
